business_goal: Allow admin users to manage the product catalog by creating, editing, updating, and deleting items.
scope: Admin can add a new item to the catalog with name, description, price, and stock quantity.
Admin can edit an existing item's name, description, and price.
Admin can update an item's stock quantity.
Admin can delete an item from the catalog.
System displays a list of all catalog items to the admin.

functional_requirements.description: Admin can add a new item to the catalog with name, description, price, and stock quantity.
Admin can edit an existing item's name, description, and price.
Admin can update an item's stock quantity.
Admin can delete an item from the catalog.
System displays a list of all catalog items to the admin.

non_functional_requirements.description: Item CRUD operations should complete within 2 seconds under normal load.
The admin interface must be responsive on desktop and tablet screens.
Only authenticated admin users can perform CRUD operations on items.

user_stories.goal: To manage the product catalog by adding new items
user_stories.benefit: Ensure the catalog is up-to-date with current inventory

user_stories.goal: To edit existing items in the catalog
user_stories.benefit: Keep item details accurate and current

user_stories.goal: To update stock quantities for items
To remove outdated or discontinued items
user_stories.benefit: Keep the catalog clean and relevant

acceptance_criteria.description: Given valid item details, when admin submits the add item form, a new item is created and appears in the catalog list.
Given an existing item, when admin edits and saves changes, the item's details are updated.
Given an existing item, when admin clicks delete and confirms, the item is removed from the catalog.

ui_expectations: Item list table with add/edit/delete actions

validation_rules.description: Item name must be unique within the catalog.
Item price must be a positive number.
Item stock quantity must be a non-negative integer.

constraints: Admin-only access enforced via authentication middleware
assumptions: Item SKU is auto-generated if not provided
The system supports at least 1000 items in the catalog
risks: Insecure access if authentication middleware is bypassed
